caseName: National Ass'n for the Advancement of Colored People v. Federal Power Commission
caseNameFull: National Association for the Advancement of Colored People v. Federal Power Commission and Federal Power Commission v. National Association for the Advancement of Colored People

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. Certiorari granted. Cases consolidated and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of these petitions.

Reported below: 172 U. S. App. D. C. 32, 520 F. 2d 432.
